chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he was asked about a man who leaves his house intending travel while he is fasting, so he said:
"If he departs before the middle of the day, then let him break his fast and make up that day; and if he departs after midday, then let him complete his day."

key_terms.السَّفَرَ: travel that affects the ruling of fasting
key_terms.فَلْيُتِمَّ يَوْمَهُ: let him complete his fasting day
key_terms.وَلْيَقْضِ: let him make up the fast later

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a fasting person who starts traveling before or after midday?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a fasting person who begins travel during the day. If he departs before midday, he breaks the fast and makes it up later; if he departs after zawāl, he completes that day's fast.
